title.narrative: Fostering sustainable linkages and cluster development in the Macedonian Tourism Industry in order to reduce poverty and stimulate economic growth

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to foster the competitiveness of selected clusters and networks in the FYR of Macedonia and a more equitable integration of MSMEs into local, domestic and regional value/supply chains through enhanced dynamism, collective efficiency, productivity and viable business partnerships. A cluster approach will help local firms move beyond their individual capacities, organizing themselves in dynamic production networks, developing strategic relationships with other firms and institutions to improve their competitive advantages based on economies of scale, innovation and learning. The proposed project will also strengthen the relevant business support institutions and government bodies to provide required services and assistance schemes to these clusters, thus building local and national capabilities by training and coaching. To this end, the project will also upgrade the offer of service providers by enhancing their institutional capacities and enabling them to assess and address gaps of assistance in an effective and sustainable manner. Lastly, the project will enhance regional and cross-border cluster to cluster cooperation thereby offering opportunities for mutual learning and exchange while at the same time promoting economic growth and development in the region.
